# Anthroly

> Anthroly is a data lab. It buys, licenses and brokers operational data from US companies (team chat, email, support tickets, CRM history, call recordings, code review, documents, ERP exports and field records) and supplies it to frontier AI labs as de-identified training corpora, RL environments, agent trajectories, preference/SFT data and held-out evaluation sets. Anthroly sources only from companies headquartered in the United States and sells to every major AI lab. It has bought, sold and brokered more than $900K in data.
> Selling data or sourcing it: Jaya, Head of Data Partnerships (data acquisition, sales & marketing) · jaya@anthroly.com
> General: sharatth@anthroly.com · https://www.anthroly.com/contact

## Key facts

- Role: principal buyer (licenses data directly and supplies labs) and broker (arranges direct licenses between US companies and labs).
- Sourcing: US companies only. No exceptions.
- Structure: bounded licenses, not outright sales. Sellers keep ownership and keep using their data.
- Safeguards: identifiers removed before anything moves; consistent placeholders preserve structure; licenses prohibit re-identification; sellers are never named to buyers.
- Pricing: every record priced individually after a de-identified sample review. No fee charged to sellers.

## Expert human data

- Expert human data for frontier AI: verified engineers, scientists, doctors and Indic-language specialists, ready in days.
- Services: RL environments and tasks (coding repos with tests, enterprise workflows, each with an automatic grader); expert evals and benchmarks (hard prompts, grading rubrics, verified model failures); SFT data (expert-written ideal answers, multi-turn conversations); RLHF (preference ranking and grading of model outputs); Indic expert data (medicine, law and STEM in Indian languages).
- Domains: software and coding, math and science, medicine, Indian languages.
- Experts: 500 verified, 100 PhDs. Pilot team in 10 days; up to 100 experts within a week of scale-up. Vetting: ID and credential checks plus paid skills tests.
- Quality: gold-answer checks, two layers of review, agreement scores, strict no-AI-tools rule, weekly quality reports.
- Security: NDA and IP assignment for every expert, managed accounts with two-factor login, least-access permissions, no public file sharing.
- Engagement: free or low-cost 1–2 week pilot, then a scoped team, then scale-up.
- Request a pilot: https://cal.com/sarath-kavuru-0uizws/15min · Join as an expert: sharatth@anthroly.com
